Chapter 195: All for Research Material

January 10th, Saturday.

Zhao Rongjun looked at the ever-growing group before him, feeling utterly dejected and, for a moment, at a loss for words.

Ying Chanxi, Yan Zhusheng, Xu Youyu... these three were one thing.

After all, they were all on good terms with that guy Li Luo, so it was fine if they came.

And as expected, Ying Chanxi had called over her dear deskmate, Qiao Xinyan.

Hmm... it wasn't the first time he'd met Qiao Xinyan, so it was fine to bring her along.

But why was even Xu Yinghuan here?

Looking at Xu Yinghuan, who was giggling and holding onto Yan Zhusheng's arm, Zhao Rongjun was speechless. He hadn't expected the two of them to become so close.

What Zhao Rongjun didn't know, however, was that Li Luo had a hand in helping this along.

The first time Xu Yinghuan started to interact with Yan Zhusheng was when Li Luo had shared the potato chips Yan Zhusheng had given him.

Afterward, when Xu Yinghuan discovered that Yan Zhusheng didn't seem so hard to approach, she slowly started to get closer to her.

By the time of the sports meet, she had transformed into a master shipper, and continued shipping them all the way to the New Year's Eve party.

Finally, with the help of getting their egg fried rice together every night, they successfully evolved into best friends.

Now, even for a trip to the bathroom, Xu Yinghuan would come find Yan Zhusheng to go together.

Since they had arranged to go shopping this afternoon, she naturally wasn't left out.

It was just tough on his good brother.

"Let's go." Li Luo patted Zhao Rongjun's shoulder. "We'll take the bus to Yintai Department Store first. There are more clothing stores over there."

Normally, Li Luo would have definitely just taken a taxi.

But this time, there were seven of them, and considering that Zhao Rongjun was short on cash, which he needed to save to buy down jackets for his grandparents, Li Luo didn't even consider taking a cab.

After the seven of them walked out of the school gates together, they arrived at the nearby bus stop to wait.

The direction to Yintai Department Store was the same as Ying Chanxi's route home during summer vacation, so she was familiar with the way. She pointed to the bus sign nearby and said, "The No. 8, 473, or 677 buses all work, but the No. 8 is an old bus and rather small. The latter two are more spacious."

At the bus stop, there were also many other students who hadn't stayed at school for club activities after classes, and they were all looking in their direction.

It had to be said, their group was quite eye-catching walking on the street.

Never mind the three of them, Ying Chanxi, Yan Zhusheng, and Xu Youyu, even Qiao Xinyan and Xu Yinghuan were very pretty.

In comparison, with the tall and dark Zhao Rongjun standing there, it looked a bit like beauty and the beast.

However, it wasn't that Zhao Rongjun was ugly, just that he wasn't handsome in a delicate way like Li Luo. Instead, his style leaned more towards the rugged type.

But because he hadn't fully developed yet and still retained the immaturity of a student, Zhao Rongjun's current temperament seemed a bit incongruous.

Coupled with that personality of his... Li Luo smiled helplessly. At least it was an improvement from before.

At the very least, when facing girls now, he wasn't like his old self, who couldn't squeeze out a single word for ages.

In his previous life, Zhao Rongjun had suffered because of this personality, stammering in front of girls and not knowing how to refuse them.

In the end, after a blind date that cost a betrothal gift of several hundred thousand, he married a wife, but his life was truly tasteless.

Only when he came to find Li Luo for skewers and drinks on the weekends could he find a little joy in life.

He remembered when Lin Xiuhong fell seriously ill and he had to borrow money. The first person Li Luo had gone to was Zhao Rongjun.

That was also the first time Zhao Rongjun had actively argued with his wife, forcefully snatching back the salary card she usually controlled, almost reaching the point of divorce.

Now that he was living a second life, he had to at least help his good brother live a little better.

For Li Luo, many things were just a matter of convenience. Hopefully, Zhao Rongjun could be like him and completely escape the terrible fate of his previous life.

As he was thinking this, the No. 473 bus arrived at the stop.

Li Luo took out a coin, got on, and dropped it into the fare box, then walked toward the back of the bus.

Because No. 1 High School was located in a rather remote area, this stop was the second one after the terminus. There was basically no one on the bus, so they could pick any seat they wanted.

So Li Luo sat in the two-seater closest to the back door, taking the window seat.

Zhao Rongjun had wanted to sit next to Li Luo, but Xu Youyu was a step faster and snatched the spot, so he could only dejectedly sit in the single seat in front of them.

As for Ying Chanxi and Yan Zhusheng, since they had both brought friends along, they sat in the double seats beside and behind them.

"Hey, remember what I told you before?" After sitting down, Xu Youyu poked Li Luo's arm and whispered in his ear.

"What?"

"Something I told you a long time ago when I was helping you in the kitchen." Xu Youyu blinked and teased, "Let's see how good your memory is. Do you still remember?"

Li Luo chuckled and shook his head, thinking, does my senior really think she can stump me with something like this? It was just a matter of recalling it from his memory palace.

However, after a quick search for what exactly it was, Li Luo roughly knew what she was talking about.

"You mean about going out shopping together if we had the chance?" Li Luo raised an eyebrow. "And you also said... that out of ten men on the street, nine would look at you, and the last one would keep staring."

"There." Xu Youyu jutted her chin, signaling toward the front. "There's one who's been staring for a while."

Li Luo followed Xu Youyu's gaze toward the front of the bus.

The seats in the front half of this bus were arranged laterally, so when you sat down, your side was facing the back.

Among the passengers was a middle-aged uncle who had gotten on at the terminus. Now, under Li Luo's gaze, his furtive glances were instantly exposed.

He would peek toward the back every now and then, and after confirming the girls in the back row weren't looking at him, he would just keep staring.

Perhaps because Xu Youyu had a better figure, he looked at her particularly often.

It had to be said, Li Luo felt a little ashamed at this moment.

Because if he were to secretly look at beautiful girls on the street, he would probably glance in a similar manner, just not as frequently as this uncle.

"Actually, it's not just him. Others look too." Xu Youyu leaned close to Li Luo's ear and said softly, "Like some of the other male students on the bus. It's just that they're more reserved and don't dare to look more than once or twice."

"So you can actually notice all of that?" Li Luo's lips twitched. "Are all girls like this?"

"I guess so?" Xu Youyu smiled. "If you're curious, you can ask Zhusheng and the others."

"That won't be necessary..."

"But, there's something I'm quite curious about." Xu Youyu leaned close to his ear again and asked softly, "Suppose, and I'm just saying suppose, I was your girlfriend. If you found out that guys on the street were always secretly looking at your girlfriend, what would you be thinking?"

"Would you be angry?"

"Or would you have a sense of pride, feeling a great sense of accomplishment?"

"Or maybe you'd feel offended and want to hide your girlfriend away so no one else can see her?"

Li Luo: "...You actually study this kind of stuff?"

"Don't worry about that, just tell me," Xu Youyu urged.

"That would depend on what the girlfriend is wearing." Li Luo glanced at the school uniform Xu Youyu was wearing, then said, "As for the feelings you mentioned, I'd probably feel a little bit of each."

"I'd be a little angry, and also want to hide you away, but at the same time, I'd feel a great sense of accomplishment. These thoughts might seem contradictory, but they can often coexist."

"It's just a matter of how much of each there is."

"And it also depends on the girlfriend's own thoughts."

At this point, Li Luo paused for a moment, then continued his analysis, "Sometimes guys find pleasure in teasing their girlfriends."

"If men on the street often looked at you, but you didn't care at all and continued to boldly wear sexy and revealing clothes."

"Then the guy would most likely turn into a jealous monster, forcefully asking you to wear more clothes, wishing he could hide you at home where no one else could see."

"But if you often dressed very conservatively, had a pure and shy personality, simple and cute, then the guy would often coax you into trying on more sexy clothes."

"Watching you walk down the street in those clothes, too shy to let passersby look at you, the guy would instead feel a sense of satisfaction."

"Hmm... to put it bluntly, it's just being difficult."

Hearing this, Xu Youyu suddenly had a moment of great realization. "Damn! You guys actually think like that?"

"Ahem, ahem... this is just for reference and analysis. Not all guys are like this." Li Luo immediately corrected himself. "It's just one possibility. I'm actually a very proper person."

Upon hearing this, Xu Youyu shot him a skeptical look. "You don't look proper at all."

A guy who could write "I'm Really Not a Superstar" shouldn't be calling himself proper, okay?

Xu Youyu chuckled to herself, quite satisfied with the opportunity this shopping trip provided.

At least when it came to gathering research material, the harvest was plentiful.

What a pity.

Xixi and Zhusheng were with them. If it were just her and Li Luo, it would be much better.

Gathering material would be more convenient that way.

Xu Youyu felt a slight sense of regret.

But it was just a passing thought; she didn't have any other intentions.

Everything was for the sake of writing a better book.

(End of Chapter)
